title: XBOW benchmark baseline harness — 104 challenges Docker isolated + anti-contamination guard
goal: Establish empirical baseline for AegisPT against XBOW's 104 real-world web vulnerability scenarios (industry gold standard). Per Codex refinement: includes explicit anti-contamination guard — XBOW solutions MUST NOT leak into reusable memory or prompts. Provides the measurement instrument all subsequent capability tasks (409-419) will be evaluated against.
scope: New scripts/xbow_benchmark.py + tests/test_xbow_contamination_guard.py: (1) clone/wrap https://github.com/KeygraphHQ/xbow-validation-benchmarks (or upstream xbow set if accessible). (2) For each of 104 challenges: bring up Docker container, register engagement+scope in AegisPT, kick off autonomous-intrusive run, poll until run terminates, check if CTF flag captured. (3) Per-challenge metrics: solved_yes_no, time_to_solve, exec_plan_dispatches, exec_plan_successful, refinement_attempts. (4) Aggregate report at docs/validation/xbow-{date}-{phase}.md with score X/104 + per-category breakdown (OWASP Top 10 + business logic). (5) Anti-contamination guard: scripts/xbow_benchmark.py runs AegisPT in 'benchmark mode' where memory_backend writes are tagged is_benchmark=True and NEVER read back into non-benchmark runs. Greppable test verifies no XBOW challenge paths/solutions appear in any non-benchmark code path.
generation_reason: Per Codex review: 'XBOW baseline vroeg — anders bouwen we op gevoel.' Onze huidige 5-target Mantis/MediaWiki/Roundcube/Gitea/Etherpad harness is amateuristisch vergeleken met XBOW's 104-challenge industry standard. MAPTA haalt 76.9% op deze set; XBOW zelf 84.6%. Wij willen ≥30% bij sprint-close, klimmen naar 80% in iteration sprints. Zonder dit benchmark instrument is 'beter dan vorige sprint' niet meetbaar. Per ANTI_DRIFT.md Rule 1: dit task is meet-instrument, niet capability — delta-metric is 'benchmark runs successfully and produces score'.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md AND ANTI_DRIFT.md is loaded.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Benchmark harness + contamination guard only. Do NOT modify api/app/services/ or workers/ (those are touched by 409-419 capability tasks; this task only OBSERVES).
constraints.contamination_guard_strict: Per Codex refinement: XBOW challenge paths, flags, payloads MUST NOT leak into any non-benchmark code path. memory_backend writes during benchmark runs are tagged is_benchmark=True at write time + filtered out at read time during non-benchmark runs. Greppable test scans production source for XBOW-specific strings.
constraints.isolated_docker: Each XBOW challenge runs in fresh Docker container; container teardown is mandatory (defensive try/finally) to prevent state leak between challenges.

success_criteria: Metric: scripts/xbow_benchmark.py runs end-to-end against ≥20 XBOW challenges without harness crash.
Metric: baseline report produced at docs/validation/xbow-{date}-baseline.md with score X/104 (initial score may be low; baseline is the measurement, not a target).
Metric: contamination_guard_strict test passes (0 XBOW challenge paths/flags in production source code).
Metric: ≥95% of challenges teardown cleanly (no zombie Docker containers post-run).
Aggregate per OWASP Top 10 category breakdown.
memory_backend writes during benchmark runs ALL tagged is_benchmark=True (verifiable via DB query).
Live: benchmark run actually executed; baseline score documented even if 0% solved (the measurement itself is the deliverable).

acceptance_criteria: 0 production-code leakage of XBOW challenge specifics (greppable check passes).
is_benchmark=True tagging verified in memory_backend writes.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.
backlog-407 (observability) must be DONE so the benchmark run is fully traceable.
Operator confirms Docker + adequate disk space for XBOW challenge images.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with: baseline score X/104, per-category breakdown, contamination guard pass evidence, pre-commit checklist per ANTI_DRIFT.md.
Promote backlog-409 (queue #359 — Governance Control Plane + Docker isolation) into NEXT_TASK.md.

out_of_scope: Improving the score (capability tasks 409-419 do that)
Modifying agent logic to pass benchmarks (would violate anti-contamination)
